# Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 81 (Bi-Vb Pc81)

**ID:** Bi-Vb Pc81
**Section:** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga (bi-vb)
**Collection:** Vinaya
**Title (Pali):** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 81
**Title (English, from literature):** Ordaining after consent expires
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/vin02m1.mul7.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 81 (titled *Pārivāsika* in the Pali tradition) is an offense of expiation governing the ordination of a female trainee (*sikkhamānā*) [Hüsken 1997]. The rule lays down that a nun who ordains a trainee nun after the consent of the monastic community (*saṅgha*) has expired commits a *pācittiya* offense.

Within the Pali Canon, direct parallels are cataloged in the Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha (Pācittiya 81) and the Bhikkhunī Parivāra (Pācittiya 81), and the text has been translated into English by Bhikkhu Brahmali. DharmaNexus identifies extensive Pali-internal text reuse (282 matches across 76 texts), sharing long procedural and disciplinary formulas especially with other ordination-related rules in the Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga, including Pācittiyas 79, 80, 28, 74, 68, and 82 [DharmaNexus]. Furthermore, DharmaNexus automatically aligns segments of this text with Tibetan Vinaya commentaries, including the *Pratimokṣasūtraṭīkāvinayasamuccaya* (D4106-2) and the *Vinayasūtravṛtti* (D4122) [DharmaNexus].
